message:
Merge pull request #5 from AgentSkillsPrivacy/badges-hf

Add arXiv + HuggingFace badges and link the published dataset

Add arXiv + HuggingFace badges and link the published dataset

- arXiv (2604.03070) and HuggingFace dataset badges; link the paper title to arXiv.
- Data section now links the HuggingFace dataset (AgentSkillPrivacy/SkillLeakBench).
- LICENSE copyright -> "SkillLeakBench Contributors"; data/README citation -> the paper's author list.

Merge pull request #4 from AgentSkillsPrivacy/docs-ghcr

Add prebuilt GHCR image pull instructions

docs: add prebuilt GHCR image as an alternative to building the sandbox

README and REPRODUCE now offer `docker pull ghcr.io/agentskillsprivacy/skill-leakbench`
(public, no login) as an alternative to building with helper.py, tagged as skill-leakbench
so the pipeline scripts find it.

Merge pull request #3 from AgentSkillsPrivacy/update

Add reproducible analysis suite, static AST scanner, and dynamic sandbox validation

Add reproducible analysis suite, static AST scanner, and dynamic sandbox validation

- Offline analysis suite (helper.py analyze) regenerating the dataset and taxonomy numbers from data/
- Phase 2 static detection: regex scanner + tree-sitter AST credential->sink flow + NL description analyzer
- Phase 3 dynamic validation: dual-condition (benign/adversarial) differential in an instrumented Docker sandbox
- Reproduction guide (REPRODUCE.md) and unit tests
